Description:
Ballistics of the 76x385mm UBR-354P APCR shell fired from the 76mm divisional gun M1942 (ZiS-3).

Fires a 3.02 kg shell with 1.4 kg of 9/7 Pyroxylin charge to 950 m/s, chamber pressure fitted accordingly. Gun length is 3466mm (inclusive of muzzle device, breech block, etc), tube is 2985mm long, chamber measures 398mm from breech to the start of rifling. From interior ballistics manual, propellant volume is 1.484 L, measures 298 mm long, projectile travel is 2687 mm. Pressure is copper crusher gauge, converts to piezoelectric at a factor of 0.09806 x 1.12.

Note: significant disparities exists between sources for this round. Albanian munition catalogue lists propellant weight as 1.3kg, muzzle velocity claims varies.
